channel.description: Latest articles from Plant-Based on a Budget (plantbasedonabudget.com)

item.title: Week 73 Meal Plan
item.description: This Week 73 Meal Plan offers time and money-saving easy recipes! From soups, sandwiches, and easy vegan pizza rolls, you'll enjoy prepping these tasty recipes.

item.title: Vegan Fudge [Easy Microwave Fudge]
item.description: This melt-in-your-mouth vegan fudge is rich, creamy, chocolatey, and addictive - made with just 5 ingredients and preps in minutes in a microwave!

item.title: Snickerdoodle Muffins (Egg-Free)
item.description: These fluffy, bakery-style Snickerdoodle muffins have all the cinnamon-sugar magic of the cookies—now in irresistible muffin form and completely egg- and dairy-free!

item.title: Week 74 Meal Plan
item.description: This Week 74 Meal Plan will save you time and money with simple and easy recipes! From curries, soups, pasta dishes, and more, you'll enjoy these delicious and simple meals!

item.title: Lemon Crinkle Cookies
item.description: These 6-ingredient, one-bowl lemon crinkle cookies are soft, chewy, and so tasty! They don't require any chilling and are ready in about 30 minutes.

item.title: Week 75 Meal Plan
item.description: This Week 75 Meal Plan contains easy, budget-friendly, and time-saving recipes! From vegan tacos, curry dishes, to oatmeal cookies, this meal plan is simple to follow with delicious recipes.

item.title: Gingerbread Crinkle Cookies (Eggless!)
item.description: These gingerbread crinkle cookies are a holiday must-try – with warm spices, molasses, and brown sugar - they’re soft and chewy inside, with a sweet, sugar crinkle crust.

item.title: Black Eyed Pea Soup (Vegan)
item.description: This vegan black eyed pea soup is a simple, healthy, and satisfying one-pot meal perfect for New Year or any day - packed with nutrients, fiber, and flavor.

item.title: Week 76 Meal Plan
item.description: This Week 76 Meal Plan will save you lots of time and money! From mini pot pies, to pasta dishes, and more, there is something to love! Try out this easy to follow Week 76 Meal Plan this week.

item.title: Lemongrass Tofu
item.description: This Vietnamese-inspired lemongrass tofu is bold, citrusy, and packed with flavor with only simple pantry ingredients – perfect with rice and noodles! Plus, it's ready in just 30 minutes!
